video_title: NBA Gear Haul  !!Everything The NBA Gave Me For The New Season!

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark discusses his new contract and gear from Adidas
quotes.excerpt: I just resigned with Adidas so they flooded my locker with a whole bunch of new stuff.
quotes.quote: I just resigned with Adidas so they flooded my locker with a whole bunch of new stuff. I'm going to be showing you two shoes that I actually play in and that I'm going to be actually giving these shoes away. They're size 14s. They're both Anthony Edwards, so if you guys are interested in some Anthony Edwards, go ahead and comment down below.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark announces a change in his giveaway strategy
quotes.excerpt: This is the last time I'm going to be doing giveaways like this.
quotes.quote: This is the last time I'm going to be doing giveaways like this. From now on, I'm going to be doing first-come, first-served for the people that have my notification on, reward the Noti Gang and stuff, but this will be the last one open to everybody.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the benefits of wearing low-key team gear
quotes.excerpt: It's nice to be able to wear our team gear and it not be loud.
quotes.quote: It's nice to be able to wear our team gear and it not be loud. You don't want everyone to know you play in the NBA everywhere you go, obviously. So being able to throw something on where it says it real small, I think that's really beneficial and dope. And I'm just a simplistic dude anyway.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the importance of anonymity for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: It's nice to be able to wear things that just don't give it away.
quotes.quote: It's nice to be able to wear things that just don't give it away. And it makes it for me more special when I do meet people that want pictures and stuff, I'm just walking around normal because that means like they actually know who I am. They just don't like see me walking around with Timberwolves gear on and be like, oh, he must play in the NBA.
